edits.before: W-Q online — the combo is live and every squishy support is now flash-range nervous.

edits.before: Full kit: headbutt-pulverize the carry off any wave state; trample the disengage.
edits.after: Black Shield pre-negates your CC at level 3, so she controls the lane.

edits.before: Zone with combo threat — their carry farms at the range your W defines.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. It writes your spacing rules. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Morgana Dark Binding is a flat 10s-cooldown root — minion-block it, but the pool follows wherever it lands. - Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, down to 16s at rank 5 — force it before you commit. - Unbreakable Will (R) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Stand outside Dark Binding's 1250 range and let her spend Tormented Shadow chip for free — closing early just eats a root.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Trading chip damage into Soul Siphon sustain — her passive heals it back before your combo lands.

edits.before: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.
